title: Airbot
lede: Airbot is an assistant inside WhatsApp and iMessage that works through your inbox, calendar, Slack and CRM overnight, then messages you first with the few things that need you.

points: Connects to Gmail or Outlook, a calendar, Slack, and Salesforce or HubSpot, among other tools.
Each message arrives with the work already started: a drafted reply, a meeting brief, a booking or a CRM update.
Nothing is sent until you approve it in the chat thread.
The team says it learns from your replies and writing style, and claims SOC 2 Type II, GDPR and HIPAA compliance.
Several commenters asked how it decides what deserves an interruption; the launch material does not explain.

sections.text: Founders, lean startup teams and salespeople whose day runs through an inbox, a calendar or a CRM.
The launch comment says Airbot is free to start; paid plans are not described.
